description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git-http-backend' functionality. It defines test functions to simulate HTTP requests (GET and POST), execute the backend, and compare expected and actual outputs. The script also includes test cases to verify behavior against malicious PATH_INFO inputs.

methods.name: run_backend
methods.description: Executes the git http-backend with provided query string and path, capturing output and error streams.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP GET request to the backend, checks for a 'Status' header in the output, and compares actual response with expected output.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP POST request with a specified body, captures and verifies the response, and compares with expected.

methods.name: expect_aliased
methods.description: Checks if the backend correctly handles restricted path info, expecting error messages for malicious or out-of-bounds paths.
